projects.title: 35mm-app
projects.shortDescription: A dynamic movie database built with modern technologies to offer a smooth and enjoyable experience for cinema lovers.

detailedDescription.overview: 35mm-app: A dynamic movie database built with modern technologies to offer a smooth and enjoyable experience for cinema lovers.

TMDb API: This app used the TMDb API to provide seamless access to a vast collection of movies across various genres and time periods.
Responsive Design: High-fidelity wireframes: The design was initially structured using Adobe XD for a clear layout.
SASS implementation: During the development phase, SASS was used to bring the design to life.
Gulp: Utilized to ensure consistent breakpoints and alignment.
The app was fully responsive, designed to offer an optimal viewing experience on desktops, tablets, and smartphones, regardless of screen size or orientation.
Key Features: Created and managed a personal favorites list
Allowed users to read and leave reviews
React Router: React Router was implemented for smooth navigation, providing users with a seamless, user-friendly experience.
Contributions: Assisted in coding React components
Styled UI elements using SASS for a polished look
Organized project structure and optimized stylesheets

projects.title: Call Me Guide
projects.shortDescription: Call Me Guide is a Vancouver-based travel startup offering an advanced platform built using modern technologies like React, Laravel, and PHP. It provides real-time travel guidance, secure payments via Stripe, and interactive maps using the Google Maps API.
projects.alt: Screenshot of Call Me Guide travel app

detailedDescription.overview: Call Me Guide: A platform offering real-time travel guidance with a user-friendly interface and secure payment integration.

Technologies: PHP: Applied for server-side logic and APIs
Features: Secure payments via Stripe: Providing seamless and secure payment processing for users.
Interactive maps using the Google Maps API: Enabling users to explore travel destinations in real-time.
Real-time travel guidance and support: Offering travelers immediate and accurate travel assistance.
Contributions: Founder and main architect of the platform
Led the overall project management and development
Coordinated collaboration between frontend, backend, and design teams
Oversaw the entire project lifecycle to ensure business and technical alignment
Enhanced user experience through real-time updates and intuitive navigation
Worked on frontend design and interactivity using React

projects.title: Flag Game
projects.shortDescription: Flag Game is an interactive educational project focused on the provinces and territories of Canada.

detailedDescription.overview: Flag Game: An engaging educational game focused on Canadian geography, developed to enhance users' knowledge of Canada's provinces and territories.

Technologies: JavaScript: Used for core game logic and functionality
CSS: Applied for styling and layout of the game
Features: Interactive gameplay: Players identify the flags of Canada's provinces and territories.
Educational and fun: Suitable for students and geography enthusiasts alike, combining learning with entertainment.
Contributions: Handled the entire project from concept to completion
Designed and implemented the game flow and interaction logic
Developed the core functionality using Java
Created the user interface and visual elements with CSS
Ensured the game is both educational and engaging for users
Managed all aspects of the project, including design, development, and testing

projects.title: Pacific Peaks
projects.shortDescription: Pacific Peaks is a website for an adventure tour business offering day and multi-day tours throughout the year, providing users with a seamless experience to explore various adventure packages across all seasons.
projects.alt: Screenshot of Pacific Peaks adventure tour website

detailedDescription.overview: Pacific Peaks is a new business project built with WordPress. The project is currently ongoing and has not been fully launched yet. Pacific Peaks offers adventure tours ranging from one-day to multi-day options in all four seasons with various packages.

Technologies: WordPress and WooCommerce: The platform is built using these powerful tools for flexibility and e-commerce functionality.
Custom WordPress theme: A fully customized theme developed to meet the unique needs of the business.
PHP: Custom backend code written to manage specific functionalities of the site.
SASS: Applied for a more structured and maintainable approach to styling.
Security and SEO plugins: Integrated to ensure optimal performance and security.
Features: Booking System: Integrated booking functionality with availability calendars for real-time tour scheduling.
Interactive Maps: Users can view tour routes and destinations via interactive maps.
Contributions: Collaborated in the initial planning phase of the project
Focused on backend development, writing custom PHP code for the WordPress theme
Worked extensively on styling the pages using SASS to ensure a polished and consistent design
Contributed to the integration of WooCommerce and other WordPress functionalities
Helped implement SEO and security plugins to enhance the performance and safety of the website

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.shortDescription: A modern and responsive portfolio website built with React to showcase projects and skills.
projects.alt: Screenshot of Mahdi Roozbahani's portfolio website

detailedDescription.overview: This portfolio website was built using React to showcase my projects, skills, and experience in front-end development. It serves as an interactive platform for potential clients and employers to learn more about my work.

Technologies: React: Used for dynamic component management and to create an interactive user experience.
SASS: Applied for clean, maintainable, and responsive styling.
SiteGround: The website is hosted on SiteGround, ensuring reliable performance and uptime.
Vite: Deployed with Vite for fast build times and efficient development.
Features: Project Showcase: Includes an interactive slider to showcase projects with smooth navigation.
Responsive Design: Ensures compatibility across all devices, from desktops to smartphones.
Animations: Smooth text and image animations powered by CSS and Framer Motion for enhanced user experience.
JSON-based Content: All content is dynamically sourced from JSON files, allowing easy updates without modifying the code.
Contributions: Designed and developed the entire site structure and layout.
Created custom React components for dynamic and reusable UI elements.
Styled all UI elements using SASS, ensuring design consistency and responsiveness.
Implemented a JSON-based content management system for easier future updates.
Ensured cross-browser compatibility and optimized performance for faster load times.
